SELECT s.id, s.student_id, s.name, s.sex, s.major, s.class_name, s.academy, s.position, avatar.file_url AS avatar, COALESCE(article_count.total, 0) AS article_count, COALESCE(resource_count.total, 0) AS resource_count FROM it_student s LEFT JOIN student_file avatar ON avatar.id = s.avatar_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM article GROUP BY student_id ) article_count ON article_count.student_id = s.student_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM resources GROUP BY student_id ) resource_count ON resource_count.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.student_id
